title: What do you see?
text: The image shows four groups of the additive group $$x+1$$

title: Which relationship?
text: The image depicts multiplication with multiple copies of the group $$x+1$$. The image depicts addition, with the block $$x$$ added to the block $$1$$.

title: Putting it together
text: Putting it together, the image illustrates the fact that $$4$$ copies of $$x+1$$ is $$4x+4$$. This is the distributive rule: $$a(b+c)=ab+ac.$$
